config.title: Quant
config.daemon.host: Host of the local market data daemon.
config.daemon.port: Port of the local market data daemon.
config.daemon.autoConnect: Connect to the market data daemon on startup.
config.daemon.allowSimulatedFeed: When no daemon is reachable, drive the UI with synthetic ticks. Off by default, and never a source of bars. Development only.
config.bars.url: Root of a published historical bars service. Charts read it directly, so real history draws with no daemon installed. Empty disables historical charts; it does not substitute invented prices.
config.watchlist.refreshIntervalMs: How often the watchlist tree coalesces and repaints price updates. Ticks arrive far faster than this; the tree is DOM-backed and must not repaint per tick.
config.nautilus.projectPath: Directory of the strategies project containing backtests/run_json.py. Defaults to the first workspace folder.
config.nautilus.pythonPath: Python interpreter to run backtests with. Defaults to .venv/bin/python inside the project directory.
config.backtest.bars: Number of bars to fetch for a backtest.
config.backtest.params: Extra strategy config values, merged into the strategy's config object.
config.engine.projectPath: Directory of a quant engine checkout, containing python/quant. Leave empty when the engine is installed into the interpreter below. Defaults to the open folder, but only when that folder is itself a checkout.
config.engine.pythonPath: Python interpreter to run the engine with. Set this to an interpreter the quant engine is installed in; with a checkout instead, it defaults to .venv/bin/python (Scripts\python.exe on Windows) inside that checkout.
